verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax's monitoring feature can flag jurisdictions where past transactions may have created nexus/registration obligations (docs-7, docs-17), which partially covers 'see where I already owe,' but there is no evidence of importing external historical transactions to compute estimated liability, penalties, or interest per jurisdiction. Missing for 10: import/backfill of non-Stripe historical transactions for exposure analysis, calculation of estimated back tax liability, and penalty/interest estimation per jurisdiction.
